# Experimental hidden Sequence Activity limit<AvailableFrom v="4.0.535" />

Limit nearby hidden scenes discovered by experimental Sequence Activity in the Remotion Studio, including nested sequences and their ancestors. Visible, premounted, and postmounted scenes always render. Defaults to 20. Must be a non-negative safe integer. Set to 0 to disable hidden discovery. Only applies when experimental Sequence Activity is enabled. Does not affect rendering.

## CLI flag

```text
--experimental-sequence-activity-limit <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setExperimentalSequenceActivityLimit(20);
```
